name: Landsat
tagline: 50+ years of continuous Earth imaging — Landsat 1 to 9
description: The longest continuous record of Earth imaging in history — Landsat 1 launched 1972 (originally as ERTS-1), continuing through Landsat 9 (2021). Currently operational pair Landsat 8 (2013) + Landsat 9 (2021) at 705 km sun-synchronous orbit, 98.2° inclination. 30 m multispectral resolution. NASA builds + launches; USGS operates and distributes data. Free public access since 2008 turned Landsat into the global reference dataset for climate change, deforestation, and urban growth.
best_known_for: 50+ years of continuous Earth imaging — Landsat 1 to 9
